chemistry-killer-03.title: Dem put 14 g
chemistry-killer-03.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-killer-03.material: Dem put 14 g of nitrogen ($\mathrm{N_2}$) and 4 g of hydrogen ($\mathrm{H_2}$) inside container and react dem completely to make ammonia ($\mathrm{NH_3}$). Di reaction na $\mathrm{N_2 + 3H_2 \rightarrow 2NH_3}$, di atomic masses na H=1, N=14, and di reaction dey continue until one reactant finish. Which one correctly match, in order, di mass (g) of $\mathrm{NH_3}$ wey form after di reaction and di volume of all di gases inside di container after di reaction wey dem convert to standard conditions (STP, 1 mol = 22.4 L)?
chemistry-killer-03.s.s1.prompt: Dem put 14 g of nitrogen ($\mathrm{N_2}$) and 4 g of hydrogen ($\mathrm{H_2}$) inside container and react dem completely to make ammonia ($\mathrm{NH_3}$). Di reaction na $\mathrm{N_2 + 3H_2 \rightarrow 2NH_3}$, di atomic masses na H=1, N=14, and di reaction dey continue until one reactant finish. Which one correctly match, in order, di mass (g) of $\mathrm{NH_3}$ wey form after di reaction and di volume of all di gases inside di container after di reaction wey dem convert to standard conditions (STP, 1 mol = 22.4 L)?
chemistry-killer-03.s.s1.explain:
Step 1: Moles. $\mathrm{N_2}$ 14 g ÷ 28 g/mol = 0.5 mol, $\mathrm{H_2}$ 4 g ÷ 2 g/mol = 2 mol.
Step 2: Compare di values wey dem divide by di coefficients. $\mathrm{N_2}$: 0.5/1 = 0.5, $\mathrm{H_2}$: 2/3 ≈ 0.67. $\mathrm{N_2}$, wey get di smaller value, na di limiting reactant.
Step 3: If $\mathrm{N_2}$ 0.5 mol react completely, $\mathrm{H_2}$ 1.5 mol go finish and $\mathrm{NH_3}$ 1.0 mol go form. Mass = 1.0 × 17 = 17 g. $\mathrm{H_2}$ wey remain = 2 − 1.5 = 0.5 mol.
Step 4: Total moles of gas after di reaction = 1.0 + 0.5 = 1.5 mol → STP volume = 1.5 × 22.4 = 33.6 L.
Answer: 17 g, 33.6 L (c). (Wrong answers: 22.4 L na value wey ignore di remaining H2, 34 g na value wey no multiply di coefficient 2 by di moles of NH3 and confuse di moles of N2 and H2, and 8.5 g na value wey wrongly see N2 : NH3 as 1 : 1)
chemistry-killer-03.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
chemistry-killer-03.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
